profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a full‑stack software engineer with over 23 years of experience building and scaling enterprise‑level applications. I specialize in turning complex business challenges into clean, efficient, and maintainable software.

My background spans front‑ and back‑end development, mainly in the Microsoft ecosystem with modern web technologies. Over the years, I’ve led projects from greenfield architecture to performance optimization and long‑term platform growth.

I work with C#, ASP.NET, .NET (Framework and Core), MVC, React, JavaScript, and SQL Server, among other tools. Whether I’m modernizing legacy systems or building something new, I focus on clarity, scalability, and durability.

I care deeply about writing clean code, designing thoughtful architectures, and continually improving the systems I build. I take pride in delivering software that’s not just functional, but dependable and built to last.
